text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Turkish trade delegation to visit Baghdad in next few days.
- Turkey is adopting new measures to speed up traffic of trucks loaded with food for Iraq.

- Iraq complains to the U.N. Security Council about recent remarks by U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright on Iraq. Iraqi U.N. envoy Nazar Hamdoun has submitted a letter to the council to this effect.
- Speaker of National Assembly Saadoun Huammadi says Iraq granted some Arab countries from 1973 to 1981 a total of $4.8 billion as aid and loans.
(The above were also carried by Qadissiya and Jumhouriya)
- Jordanian prime minister criticises Albright's statement on Iraq.
- Iraq and Jordan discuss industrial cooperation.
- Libya defies U.N. air emargo by sending a plane carrying pilgrims to Mecca.
